notes: Banter fires on flags, not on a timer. Intro once, mid when the named flag flips, postboss only if the player holds that remembrance.
Assist verbs are existing skill_* ids. SkillLattice is still a lookup until ActionRunner windows change.
Bodies are CX. No Quaternius. Brackish is a child: scout and gossip only, no romance, no combat puppet.
Pillars (Concordia, Concord, Sovereign) are not companions.

companions.name: Brackish
companions.assist_note: Points at a real plaza fact. Does not fight.

intro.line: If you stand still the Court will tell you a secret. I already heard it.

mid.line: You gave me bread. I am still deciding.

postboss.line: You came back with a thing from a boss and you did not try to impress me with it.

companions.name: Old Seam
companions.assist_note: Walks the next post. Does not close the gap with Nesha unless that quest says so.

intro.line: Walk soft. I have mended this street since before the gates had names.

mid.line: Quartus. She is on the other ring. We are not speaking.

postboss.line: A remembrance is not a reunion. Do not ask me to pretend it is.

companions.name: Maren Ashveil
companions.assist_note: Writes what was seen. Strikes inference from the fact book.

intro.line: Write what you see. Not what the embassies will claim you saw.

mid.line: That is an inference. It goes in the second book.

postboss.line: If this token is a story, say who held it. If you did not see the fight, say that.

companions.name: Arena Warden Gale
companions.assist_note: Parry only on Arena sand. Inside the 42m Court she uses skill_presence_flower_law and will not swing steel.

intro.line: The Court forbids conquest. The sand does not. Poise, not luck.

mid.line: Your flower is still a flower. Good.

postboss.line: You brought a crest shard onto my sand. Sheathe it before you brag.

companions.name: Thorne Blackroot
companions.assist_note: Folds hostility inward. If the player takes the curse offer, Thorne leaves the party.

intro.line: I carry a curse I could turn outward and win with. I refuse, every day.

mid.line: The boar lived. So did you. That is the better count.

postboss.line: The crest shard is a refusal, not a trophy. Do not set it in gold.

companions.name: Maeris
companions.assist_note: Invents steps. Will not teach a ninth Refusal.

intro.line: Eight steps. Three I will make up. You will not know which until you are back.

mid.line: You planted what you cut. The verge noticed.

postboss.line: A boss token is not a crossing permit. Put it away before the bog.

companions.name: Nyx Torres
companions.assist_note: Pulls the player out of a number painted on the ground.

intro.line: He counts. I organize the uncounted.

mid.line: The stray is a dog. Leave the scar as skin.

postboss.line: That missing-number token stays dark. If you ink it, we are done.

companions.name: Jax Rivera
companions.assist_note: Produces the paper. Does not erase it. Home is the coast even though the guest stand is Hub.

intro.line: Contracts from all eight. Loyalty from none.

mid.line: The invoice landed. Do not call that cruelty.

postboss.line: A stamp from a billhound is still a bill. I will not hide it in the lining.

companions.name: Kel
companions.assist_note: Canon chain frontier_silas_02_kel asks the player to find Kel. This row binds that courier as a companion after the turn-in.

intro.line: Tell me the sound of the portal. Keep the theory.

mid.line: The letter stayed sealed. That is why I am still walking with you.

postboss.line: Remembrance in a saddlebag is fine. A mounted hero shot is not. There is no seated clip.

companions.name: Esha of the Open Table
companions.assist_note: Names who holds a mark. Will not display the open ledger in a capital.
companions.role_note: Her canon work is the open table, not enforcement. role_id is the nearest CX crowd silhouette (enforcer coat) until a dedicated plate exists. Do not give her a Tessera tile.

intro.line: The ledger works. It is small. Do not make it famous.

mid.line: One brand on the hound. A second mark is how the machine eats a name.

postboss.line: If the furnace eye saw the seed library, we turn around. The token in your hand is not worth that.

companions.name: Calla
companions.assist_note: Opens a staple. Does not start the fourth uprising from follow-mode.

intro.line: You can hear the plan. Hearing is not dawn.

mid.line: Leave the wraith unfinished. I have buried enough completed people.

postboss.line: The mask is a question. Wear it and you answered wrong.

companions.name: Vesper Kane
companions.assist_note: Adjusts a stall price to standing. Does not enter raids.

intro.line: I keep half this city fed. The other half I keep honest.

mid.line: Your standing just moved my loaf. Look at the slate before you complain.

postboss.line: Boss tokens are not currency at my stall. Sell them to a keeper if you must.
